title: Khavn Dela Cruz curates 20-film Lino Brocka retrospective in Portugal
summary: Khavn Dela Cruz is curating a retrospective titled “Lino Brocka: Kill the National Artist,” running from October 15 to 25 in Lisbon, Portugal.
